meta.purpose: Deck assignments for the decked new-word diet (SPECS/diet-deck-distribution.md)
meta.keyFormat: assignments map `${hanzi}|${pinyinNormalized}` -> deck id; words absent from assignments belong to the beyond-hsk tail deck
meta.deckPolicy: HSK 2.0 deltas; deltas over 400 words split into frequency-ordered strata of ~250 (SUBTLEX-CH-WF count desc)
